import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[9]
    C = np.cos(w*t); S = np.sin(w*t)
    tv = np.tanh(v)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*x**3 + params[3]*v + params[4]*v*np.abs(v)
            + params[5]*tv*C + params[6]*tv*S + params[7]*np.sqrt(x)*tv + params[8]*np.exp(-x)/v)
